name: île de païn - lunch & breakfast restaurant & artisan bakery
address: 10, The Boatshed, Long St, Thesen Island, Knysna, 6571, South Africa
description_short: Artisan bakery and breakfast spot on Thesen Island serving French-inspired pastries and hearty morning meals.
description_long:
Nestled in The Boatshed on Thesen Island, île de païn brings a slice of European bakery tradition to Knysna's waterfront. The aroma of fresh croissants and sourdough greets you as you step into this relaxed café, where locals queue early for the day's best pastries and visitors linger over leisurely breakfasts.

The menu balances French bakery classics with South African breakfast favourites — think buttery pain au chocolat alongside substantial eggs Benedict and wholesome grain bowls. Their artisan bread, baked fresh daily, has earned a loyal following, and the coffee pairs perfectly with a flaky almond croissant. The island location adds charm, with water views from outdoor tables and a laid-back atmosphere that suits both quick coffee runs and unhurried weekend brunches.

Whether you're grabbing takeaway sourdough for the holiday house or settling in for a proper breakfast, île de païn delivers quality without pretension. It's the kind of spot that becomes a morning ritual during a Garden Route stay.
